evaluator: scripts/chat_regression.py (--check | --refresh <case-id>=<json-path> | --table); tests/determinism/test_chat_regression_suite.py runs the same evaluation in CI

kinds.recorded-floor: a committed experiment JSON holds the metric; the FLOOR is a bound the recorded value clears with margin (never the accidental exact value, except counts that are all-or-nothing by nature); `recorded` is the value in the named source run
kinds.offline-test: named pytest functions prove the capability; the suite fails when one is deleted (entries marked live=true skip offline — CI proves only that the instrument exists)
kinds.pending: no instrument records this yet; the owner phase must record the named metric before the entry can become recorded-floor

floor_policy: floors are regression tripwires set below the recorded value (rates: recorded − 0.05…0.10, or the plan gate when that is lower); counts that are complete by nature (30/30 turns, 6/6 fixtures, 0 leaks) keep the exact bound; a floor is never raised or lowered by --refresh
